messages.subject: Problem with getUnitsOnChromosome
parts:
Hi.

I'm trying to extract the raw copy numbers in a chromosome and plot
them. To do this I followed the instructions on the "Calculating raw
total copy numbers manually" vignette. The problem is that, no matter
what chromosme I choose and using SNP 6.0, the length of units <-
getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosome=19) is 1879489. I'm guessing it is
the whole genome instead of the specific chromosome what I am getting.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Problem with getUnitsOnChromosome
parts:
Hi,

my bad. The recent April 28 patch of AromaUgpFile contained a bug
(when renaming argument 'chromosome' to 'chromosomes' the latter was
overwritten by an internal variable). I've committed a patch. After

library(aroma.affymetrix);
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix");

you should get:

> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full");
> gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf);
> units <-getUnitsOnChromosome(gi, chromosomes=19);
> str(units);
int [1:30362] 25670 25671 25672 25673 25674 25675 25676 25677 25678

Cheers

/Henrik
